name: Strife In The Church
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid the destructive beginnings of strife, comparing it to water being let out uncontrollably and urging to cease contention before it escalates. The wise are honored for refraining from strife, while anger and fury only provoke further transgression. Christ's teaching in Matthew instructs the church to address offenses privately and, if necessary, with witnesses to restore relationships biblically. Finally, Paul exhorts the church to identify and avoid those who cause divisions and contradict sound doctrine, emphasizing unity grounded in truth.
